name: Create Card Token ( {card} )
purpose: Exchanges card details (number, expMonth, expYear, cvc, optional name/address) for a QBO Payments token: validates JSON and required properties, then POSTs /tokens through 'Send Payment Request' (340) and returns the response.
open_question: Handles raw card data (PAN, cvc) in a script parameter and variable: PCI scope for the target. Step 18 (disabled) holds a sample with a test card number. Set Error Capture is Off.

name: Create Bank Account Token ( {bank} )
purpose: Exchanges bank account details for a QBO Payments token: validates required properties and business limits (routing number exactly 9 digits, account number 4-17 characters, phone exactly 10 digits), then POSTs /tokens with data.bankAccount via script 340.
open_question: Step 40 reads $bankaccount (lower case) while the variable is $bankAccount; FileMaker variable names are case-insensitive so it works. Bank data handled in script parameter (PCI/ACH sensitivity). Disabled step 13 contains a sandbox URL and test data.

name: Charge Card Token ( {chargeData })
purpose: Charges a card token: validates amount and token, defaults currency to USD, POSTs /charges via script 340 and returns the response.
open_question: Step 28 tests $currency which is never assigned in this script, so currency is always forced to USD (step 29) even if data.currency was passed.

name: Charge Bank Account ( {chargeData} )
purpose: Debits a bank account token (eCheck): validates amount, token and paymentMode, POSTs /echecks via script 340 and returns the response.

name: New Credit Card Card Charge Window
purpose: Opens the card-style window 'ChargeCardWindow' on layout in file QBO (dims parent, no close/min/max/resize) and clears the timer.
open_question: Layout ChargeCardWindow (id 132) presumably hosts the card entry form that posts back into QBO::CardResult.

name: Send Payment Request( {request} )
purpose: Single entry point to the QBO Payments REST API: validates the request (path required, method GET or POST, data required for POST), defaults method to GET, sends it with '_Send Payment Request' (337) and converts HTTP codes (>499 server error, 401 unauthorized, >399 bad request) into error objects; otherwise returns the response body.
open_question: Developer comment step 11 '##proxy2 replace' (unclear intent, may mark where a proxy call is substituted). Authentication/signing happens inside script 337 (not in this batch).

name: Charge Card ( {card, amount, currency} )
purpose: Charges a card in two steps: exchanges card data for a token (326), then builds chargeData (amount, token, currency, context.mobile, context.isEcommerce defaulting to false) and charges via 328. Returns the charge response.
open_question: $currency is read from params key 'currency' but the documented parameter is 'currencyCode' (step 28 vs doc line 8), so currencyCode is ignored; the charge script then defaults to USD.  Because 328 overwrites currency with USD, non-USD charges are not possible as written.

name: Get Card Charge Result
purpose: Returns the text in QBO::CardResult (set by the card window/web viewer) and clears the field.
open_question: QBO::CardResult#56 is a global field: hand-off of the card window result to the caller (consumed once, then cleared).

name: Debit Bank Account ( { bankaccount, amount, paymentMode})
purpose: Debits a bank account in two steps: creates a bank account token (327) from params.bankaccount, builds chargeData (amount, token, paymentMode, context) and calls 'Charge Bank Account' (329). Returns the response.
open_question: $context is used at step 87 but its assignment (72) is disabled, so context is empty in the request. Required-property validation of the whole params object is disabled (step 54). The documented key is 'params.bankaccount' (lower case); JSON keys are case-sensitive, so callers must send exactly 'bankaccount'.

name: New Bank Account Card Window
purpose: Opens the card-style window 'BankAccountCardWindow' (file QBO) and clears the timer.

name: Get Bank Account Charge Result
purpose: Returns the text in QBO::BankAccountResult (hand-off from the bank account window) and clears the field.
open_question: QBO::BankAccountResult#68 is a global field: hand-off of the bank account window result (consumed once, then cleared).
